name: Casperia (Italy)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Casperia (a serpent on red) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Casperia, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Casperia arms — serpent on red, crowned, within branches
